no_harm_rule: NO-HARM ADMITTED (owner decision 127): against the IN-CHAIN A/A arm flown in the same chain, the paired CI95 lower bound of the intent-accuracy delta (primary, decision 133) is not below -0.9943 pp AND the paired CI95 lower bound of the official pooled SLU-F1 delta (the guard) is not below -1.2485 pp -- each metric read at its own Fold A own-null half-width (PLAN vs PLANr, docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md section 2d). HARMFUL: a measured loss on either metric (CI95 upper bound below zero, decision 25). NEUTRAL-BY-WIDTH IS THE ADMISSION: a CI that includes zero and clears the margin is exactly the reading a base item requires (decision 127). The item is NEVER reported as a gain, whatever the point estimate; two base items are never assumed to add, and the cumulative check is the next composed round (decision 138). Every verdict carries the per-scenario table in both weightings, the frontier row (decision 75), the measured Reviewer prompt-token delta per contact and per row, the Reviewer contact rate, and a model-free count of Reviewer responses that narrate a tool call or a tool result on each arm (the downstream failure docs/results/2026-09-26-system-summary001-fidelity-and-feedback-diagnostic.md recorded).
